title: Formulary Benefit Tier Exceptions: Credit by the Clinical Ground Stated by the Prescriber
content:
Under the Formulary Benefit, a clinical-ground credit is added to a tier exception approval. It follows the ground stated on the latest supporting statement for the drug in the member's exception history.

| Ground on the latest supporting statement for the drug | Credit added |
|---|---|
| the lower-tier alternatives are contraindicated | **6** months |
| the lower-tier alternatives caused an adverse effect | **3** months |
| any other ground (for example, that the alternatives would be ineffective) | nothing |

Only the latest statement for the drug is read. An earlier statement giving a different ground does not change the credit. The credit is added to the tier approval period before the floor of one month is applied.

*Hypothetical.* A first statement says the preferred inhaler was ineffective, and a later statement for the same drug says it caused an adverse effect. The credit is 3 months.
